listSODBDatasetNames

Source: R/dataset_helpers.R
listSODBDatasetNames.Rd

listSODBDatasetNames

Usage

listSODBDatasetNames(
  category = c("All", "Spatial Transcriptomics", "Spatial Proteomics",
    "Spatial Metabolomics", "Spatial Genomics", "Spatial MultiOmics"),
  env_name = "giotto_env"
)

Arguments

category

name of category for which dataset names will be listed.

env_name

Python environment within which pysodb is installed. If it is not already installed, the user will be prompted to install `pysodb` DEFAULT: "giotto_env"

Details

Returns a vector containing the names of datasets associated with the provided `category`.
